name: spec-to-pr
description: Turn a brief, feature, Figma design, or legacy screen into a Korean draft pull request.

interface.shortDescription: Turn four development cases into Korean draft PRs.
interface.longDescription: SpecToPR uses one lightweight skill for brief, feature, Figma, and legacy delivery. Brief and feature delivery first prepare and review OpenSpec change documents, with optional acceptance-scenario TDD. The plugin then records visual match ratios, used APIs, and remaining Gaps. Feature delivery records one targeted E2E user-flow video.
defaultPrompt: Use the spec-to-pr skill and choose exactly one case: brief, feature, figma, or legacy.
Use the design system for UI work, or the running legacy screen as the migration baseline.

For brief and feature delivery, prepare and review OpenSpec change documents from the supplied sources before implementation. test: on uses OpenSpec acceptance scenarios for TDD; test: off is the default and skips new unit/integration tests. Create a Korean Draft PR with implemented features, visual match ratios, APIs, and Gaps. Feature delivery still runs targeted E2E and commits one user-flow video.
